email.body1:
Benny, saw Alkira's breakout growth and the Lumen acquisition news around your multi-cloud platform.

Momentum like that usually creates more in-market accounts than a regional team can cover, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Alkira off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Benny, quick follow-up for Alkira.

With growth and a big acquisition in motion, the territory number usually climbs faster than the team can. Most teams can't say how many meetings they need to book to hit target, so coverage gaps surface late and the quarter slips.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your territory needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Benny, last bit of proof for Alkira.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Alkira's reply rate likely compares to other infrastructure startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Benny, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling territory pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A growth year plus an acquisition is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a territory motion? I'll tailor it to Alkira either way.
